title: Name the SEP-10 Session Credential
description: The anchor has verified the signed challenge. The wallet now stores a credential that it sends on every subsequent SEP-24 or SEP-38 request.

content.prompt: What kind of token does a SEP-10 server return after it verifies the signed challenge? (Answer with the token acronym.)

hint: SEP-10 issues a JSON Web Token whose subject is the authenticated Stellar account. The wallet sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to the anchor's standardized endpoints. Documentation: https://developers.stellar.org/docs/platforms/anchor-platform/sep-guide/sep10
author: StellarHunts Core

testCases.title: Refresh tokens belong to other auth systems
API keys are not issued by SEP-10
